overrides.comment: Component compat shims mirror other sites' CSS verbatim so their markup keeps rendering. They live under 32-utilities/ for build order, but they are not utilities: they are emitted in @layer ss.compat, which sits below ss.components so a module wins over a shim that reuses its class name.
Legacy utility aliases (0.3 class names mapped onto ss-u- utilities); emitted in @layer ss.utilities.

Scapepress site partials (31-modules/*/_*.sites.scss, formerly the 32-utilities scapepress-parity shim): the sites' own contextual rules, which style one component inside another (.ss-c-section .ss-c-btn). The class names are the sites' markup contract, so cross-component selectors are graded as warnings here rather than rewritten.
